stations.title: Hesper
stations.say: Why does it say 3? There are 2.

stations.title: Old screen
stations.text: Header, basket and total each keep a copy.

stations.title: Your store
stations.gap: No one place for the order

captions: At Ashgrove Press, Hesper asks why the basket count says three over two lines.
Each part of the order screen keeps its own copy, and one of them missed a change.
You write a store that keeps the order in one place, in three tasks.
Now every part reads the one state, and the count matches the basket.
Same screen, same shop, and an order that lives in one place.
